Very Poor Experience – Completely Unprofessional & Misleading Service

This has been one of the worst retail experiences I’ve ever had, and I am extremely disappointed that this is the level of service being delivered under the Tata name.

Issue 1: No follow-up or accountability
I visited the store twice to buy an iPhone 16 Plus, but it was out of stock. I submitted my contact number and was assured I would be informed once stock arrived. The phone did come back in stock, but no one bothered to contact me. Zero follow-up, zero responsibility.

Issue 2: Staff not updated on offers – wasted 30 minutes
On my third visit, I went ahead with an exchange. The department head checked my old phone and proceeded with billing. After wasting over 30 minutes, he suddenly informed me that my card offer was not valid with exchange. This clearly shows that even the department head is not aware of ongoing offers or billing rules, causing unnecessary delays and frustration.

Issue 3: Defective product given after purchase
On my fourth visit, I finally purchased the phone. Shockingly, after unboxing, there were fungus stains on a brand-new phone. Instead of replacing it immediately, they tried to clean it and asked me to accept it. I refused. I was then promised a fresh unit with home delivery.

Final letdown: Refusal to deliver & absurd excuses
Today morning, I received a call from Prakash (Department Manager) advising me not to buy the black color because it may again have fungus and to choose white instead. Now he has flatly refused to deliver the phone at all.
To make matters worse, the store head is on leave, not answering calls, and there is no backup or escalation support.

Is this really the customer experience Tata wants to represent?
Multiple visits, false promises, untrained staff, defective products, and finally refusal to deliver — absolutely unacceptable.

I would strongly advise customers to think twice before visiting this store, especially for high-value purchases like iPhones.
